text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks B, D, and E after gains, but locking in a profit alone is not a sound reason to sell; I should weigh each holding’s role and risk in the portfolio.","My average cost can make losses feel especially painful, but it should not anchor my decisions: I should assess each stock’s future prospects rather than avoid admitting a mistake.","Short-term price changes have no predictive power here, so I should avoid reacting to them or trading unnecessarily and keep diversification in mind."]}
